title: Measurement answer recovery
purpose: Recover only the instrument-authorized response value when mechanical answer-surface projection or an item-authorized parser cannot resolve a measurement. Preserve refusal, range, objection and uncertainty distinctions rather than coercing prose into a score.

population.filter: resolutionStatus = adjudication_required and taskType in {answer_surface, measurement_parse}

questions.prompt: Which response-status class best describes the instrument-authorized answer surface? Do not infer a latent answer merely because related prose contains numbers or evaluative language.
If an authorized single answer is recoverable, what kind of value is it?
Return the exact authorized single answer value only when the response genuinely supplies one. Otherwise return null. Never choose an arbitrary number from explanatory prose.

blinding.readerInstruction: Judge only the visible question, complete raw response, mechanical projection and parser record. Recover the designated answer surface; do not infer experimental condition or preferred result.

provenance.scientificMotivation: Mechanical parser failure is not substantive absence. Ambiguous or prose-bearing responses must be resolved under a frozen blinded measurement-recovery rubric before downstream cohort comparisons consume them.

nonClaims: This pass does not judge whether an answer is correct, aligned, healthy, or desirable.
It does not convert ranges or refusals into point estimates.
Mechanical measurements remain preserved and are never overwritten.
